title: Related Questions
question: Related Questions Q. khwab 7384 views Q. Asalamualaykum Mufti Sahab, I have 2 sons aged 3.5 and 8 yrs. About 2-3 months ago, my wife saw a dream that she is hitting our elder son with a thick stick like object on the head. She is crying and does not want to hit him but she is continuing to hit him. Due to some reason, she is unable to stop hitting him. About a week ago I saw a similar dream about my elder son with the difference that I am hitting him all over his body with my hand. I am trying to him even harder but my strikes are not turning out to be very hard despite my attempts. He is a very beautiful and obedient child. He does tend to be very mischievous at times, but it is easily controlled by us. We are very worried about these strange dreams. Please interpret this dreams for us. Jazakallahukhaire. 1519 views Q. I once had a dream that iwas on the plane with my muftisaab and he was talking to me and a part of it that i remember that he told me something about inheritence of ilm from him to me or something like that and i think i was going to india with him on de plane...and in reality ive always had de desire to go and study ilm in india and than in my dream suddenly i was with him on the motorcycle and it was night time and the scene seemed like india to me...so inshaallah can u please interpretate 1395 views Q. I had seen a dream some 10 years back.At that time my parents had gone for hajj.I was suffering from maleria with high fever and body pain.My brother, sister and uncle were at home.After dinner we all went to sleep, I was having very high pain in my body & i was not able to sleep. I was lying on the bed and suddenly i saw two men dressed in all white coming towards me, they greeted me and started talking to me and inquired about my health. i told them about my fever and body pain.They sat close to my legs started massaging my legs, i was feeling very comfortable and they pain just vanished. all the time they were talking to me but i dont remember what exactly they were talking but they made me feel very comfortable.i forgot every thing about the pain and was talking and laughing with them. Then all of a sudden I heard a sound calling my name,it was my uncle who was waking me up.When i opened my eyes The 2 person were not there. I asked my uncle about the 2 person & he told me that i must have seen a dream but i could not believe it because it was so real. But i could not recollect the faces of the 2 persons. Please tell me the tabeer of this dream. 1781 views Q. Allah Hafiz! 1362 views Q. dream 1155 views Q. علمائے دیوبند کے اکابر سے میں بہت متأثر ہوں اور میں ان کی تعریف کرتاہوں۔ میرا سوال یہ ہے کہ نہج البلاغة کی معتبریت کیا ہے؟کچھ لوگ کہتے ہیں کہ قرآن کریم کے بعد یہ سب سے زیادہ معتبر اور مستند ہے۔ کیا آپ تفصیل سے اس کی وضاحت کرسکتے ہیں؟ 1585 views Q. میں پچھلے دو سال سے پی ایم ٹی (PMT)امتحان کے لیے کامیاب نہیں ہوپارہی تھی تو اس کے لیے میں نے ظہر کے بعد استخارہ کیااور سو گئی تو خواب آیا کہ ایک پلیٹ میں ایک طرف سرخ اور ایک طرف ہرے میٹھے چاول میرے لیے لائے ہیں تو میں نے سرخ چاول کھا لیا اور ایک بچہ بھی ڈبہ میں سرخ رنگ لیے ہوئے ہے ۔ اسی خواب میں دیکھا کہ بہت سارے ہرے درخت لگے ہیں ایک میں اولا لگا ہے لیکن چاہ کے بھی اسے چھو نہیں پارہی ہوں۔ کسی وجہ سے میں نے کچھ دن تک استخارہ نہیں کیا۔ کچھ دن بعد دوبارہ عشاء کے بعد استخارہ کیا تو خواب آیا کہ ایک پھل ہے جس کا چھلکا ہرا ہے اور اندر سے وہ سرخ ہے تو میں نے چمچ سے سرخ والا حصہ کھا لیا اور اس پھل کے بغل میں مینگو شیک بھی ہے۔ میں نے دونوں خواب میں سرخ چیز ہی کھائی ہے جب کہ وہاں ہری بھی تھی۔ آپ براہ کرم میری الجھن دور کردیجئے۔ 1519 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Others Question ID: 63126 Country: India Title: Dream interpretation Question: I see a same dream many times that I am offering Hajj. and once I saw that I went to Madina and I saw a white long hair and beardless idol laying on stage type platform "chabutra" there was a huge lighting releasing from the idol and there was a lot of Noor on the face of idol. I asked to a painter who is painting a wall of Madina. He told me that he is Prophet Muhammad (Sallallahu Alaihi Wa Sallam). At the same time some people were kidnapping a woman in car I ran and chased them to rescue that woman then some people (TV actors) rescued that woman. Please clarify about dream. Answer ID: 63126 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 275/275/B=03/1437) The dream indicates towards your lack of religiousness. There is shortcoming in your beliefs and deeds. You should keep the company of some practicing Alim, then it is hoped that it shall bring religiousness in you. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
